start: A member page; the member shows the code from "Show my workouts to the desk" on their phone

steps.action: Tap "Check workout code"
user_sees: Sheet "Check workout code" with "For the workout offer. The member opens “Show my workouts to the desk” in the app. Type the code from their phone."
A box "Workout code" with the example K3Q9P-X2M7A; "Check" is greyed until something is typed
must_not: A code box already filled with an old code

steps.action: Type the 10 letters and numbers (small letters, with or without the dash) and tap "Check"
user_sees: "8 of 9 workouts match a check-in (6 at the desk, 2 in the app)."
"Code made on <day>."
Each workout day with "✓ Checked in at the desk", "✓ Checked in on the app", "✓ Checked in at the entry machine" or "No check-in: does not count"
must_not: A workout day counted with no check-in on that day
A day after today in the list
An entry-machine check-in called "imported" in the summary line

steps.action: Tap "Give extra days"
user_sees: The extra-days step for this member opens
must_not: Days added with no further step
The button shown when no day matched

start: The "Check workout code" sheet on a member page

steps.action: Type 6 letters and tap "Check"
user_sees: "A workout code has 10 letters and numbers, like K3Q9P-X2M7A." under the box
must_not: A result list for a short code

steps.action: Type 10 letters with one changed
user_sees: "That code has a typing mistake. Check it against the member’s phone."
must_not: A made-up code read as real workout days

steps.action: Type a code with the letter U in it
user_sees: "That code has a letter a workout code never uses. Check it against the member’s phone."
must_not: The sheet closing or crashing

start: The sheet showing a result for one code

steps.action: Change one letter in the box
user_sees: The old result disappears at once until "Check" is tapped again
must_not: The result of the first code left under a different code

steps.action: Type a code the member made 5 days ago and tap "Check"
user_sees: "Code made on <day>. It is more than 3 days old: ask for a new code to see the newest workouts."
must_not: An old code shown as fresh

steps.action: Type a code from a member with no workouts in 30 days
user_sees: "This code has no workouts in its 30 days."
must_not: "0 of 0 workouts match" or a give button

steps.action: Tap "Close" and open the sheet again
user_sees: An empty box: nothing was saved
must_not: The code kept anywhere after closing

start: A member page; a code that belongs to a different member

steps.action: Type the other member code and tap "Check"
user_sees: Only the days on which THIS member checked in count; the rest read "No check-in: does not count"
must_not: The other member name, plan or anything else about them shown
The code or its days sent to a server or saved on the member
